description: Static estimate of the rendered size of interactive elements (a, button, input, select, textarea, summary, role=button/link, onclick) for WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum, 24px) and the 44px guidance. Pass `html` and `css`, or a public `url` (page plus up to 12 stylesheets). It matches CSS rules to elements, uses explicit width/height/min sizes, padding, border, line-height and font-size (with browser defaults for form controls), guesses text width, reads margins and gap including li > a wrappers, and decides whether a neighboring control exists. Output groups elements by kind with a status: fail-estimate, under-24-isolated, under-24-spaced, inline (exempt inside a sentence), unknown (icon-only with no stated size) or ok. Optional `viewport` (default 390) selects media queries. States plainly that it is an estimate and includes a Puppeteer snippet for the rendered measurement. It does not apply state, sibling or structural selectors, transforms, container queries or script-set sizes.

url.description: A public page URL to fetch.

viewport.description: Viewport width in px for media queries. Default 390.

name: touch_target_css
title: Touch target estimate from CSS
